source.member: RecipeManager.ModifyItem(Player, Recipe, WorldObject, WorldObject, WorldObject, bool)
source.notes: in.player, in.source, in.target and in.result (null: no result) are specs; in.success the flag; in.mods lists the recipe mods, each {success: ExecutesOnSuccess, data_id, rows: [[kind, index, stat, enum, source, value]]} (kind b/i/f/s/d/iid; vitals 0). ThreadSafeRandom is reseeded with in.seed. out.modified lists the modified guids (sorted), out.<role> the state of each object afterwards (i/f/b/s/d/iid rows and spells), out.post = ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 999999), or out.throws. Inputs from System.Random(5904).
